verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an AI email client. An email product could plausibly ship an API or CLI for headless automation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only in-app automation: triggers that draft replies, plain-English AI filters, and integrations via MCP, Zapier and Tasklet, all configured from the inbox UI. Nothing documents a CLI, public API or CI-runnable mode, and probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
